target: Validate a claim about data governance using a data classification and retention register. Use a small, fully specified worked case and then change one input.

competency.title: Validate data governance — worked example
competency.outcome: Validate a claim about data governance using a data classification and retention register. Use a small, fully specified worked case and then change one input.

topic_kernel.artifact: a data classification and retention register
topic_kernel.failure_to_detect: sending restricted material to an external API

competency.practice_task: Produce a preregistered test protocol and evidence record grounded in a data classification and retention register.
competency.setting_constraint: Use a small, fully specified worked case and then change one input.
required_evidence: a preregistered test protocol and evidence record
Include the solved case and the changed-case prediction.
Report policy compliance and deletion verification with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: sending restricted material to an external API.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of data governance.
Practice: a held-out challenge supports or rejects the claim.
Measurement: report policy compliance and deletion verification against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for sending restricted material to an external API; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
